cohort: 100 pregnant women with thrombocytopenia, including those with ITP or pancytopenia, with a mean age of 26.93 years and a mean BMI of 21.85 kg/m2.
finding: Thrombocytopenia in pregnancy was primarily linked to hypertensive disorders and PIH, with postpartum hemorrhage identified as a prominent maternal complication in 57.14% of cases.
mod_finding: Spinal anesthesia was preferred for cesarean sections in women with thrombocytopenia, with 88% of the 22 cesarean sections receiving it.
